_note: AUTHORED, not generated - unlike wall-plan.json and captions.json, no script writes this file. It is an ordered reading of the quarter: nine stops that follow the ground rather than the book's own order. Each stop IS an existing entry, so every word a visitor reads on the route page comes from the book via that entry. Nothing here is a practical fact.
_no_practical_facts: There are deliberately NO walking times, NO distances and NO durations in this file. Nobody has measured them. The design canvas mockup (design/Route.dc.html) shows '~2 hours' and per-stop minutes - those were placeholder content and must not be shipped. See CLAUDE.md, 'Do not invent practical facts'.
_order: The sequence is editorial: it starts at the gate that carries the museum, walks the restored wall, then works inward through the quarter and ends at the souq. The order is a suggestion, not a claim about the ground.
